hint: Speak in Marathi, Hindi or English.
hintBrowser: Speak in Marathi, Hindi or English. Your browser listens to you for this.
notSupported: Voice is not supported on this phone or browser. Please type your question.
secureNote: The microphone only works on a secure page (https). Open the secure web address of this site.
typeInstead: You can also type your question.

button.ariaBusy: Please wait, working on your question

status.error: Something went wrong. Tap to try again.

denied.title: Microphone is blocked
denied.text: This site is not allowed to use your microphone.
denied.how: To turn it on: tap the lock or settings icon next to the web address, open Microphone, choose Allow, then tap the microphone again.

noMic.title: No microphone found
noMic.text: Connect a microphone or use a phone, then try again.

busyMic.title: Microphone is busy
busyMic.text: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.

unsupported.title: Voice not supported
unsupported.text: This browser cannot record your voice.

tooShort.title: Too short
tooShort.text: That was very short. Tap the microphone, speak, then tap again.

tooBig.title: Recording too long
tooBig.text: The recording is too big. Please keep it under one minute.

badAudio.title: Could not read the audio
badAudio.text: The recording could not be used. Please try again.

noSpeech.title: Nothing heard
noSpeech.text: I could not hear any words. Speak closer to the microphone and try again.

serverBusy.title: Busy right now
serverBusy.text: Many people are asking right now. Please wait a minute and try again.

serviceDown.title: Voice service is down
serviceDown.text: Voice is not working right now. Please type your question.

signIn.title: Please sign in
signIn.text: Sign in to ask by voice.

network.title: No connection
network.text: Check your internet and try again.

askFailed.title: No answer
askFailed.text: We could not get an answer. Please try again.

unknown.title: Voice problem
unknown.text: Voice did not work this time. Please try again or type your question.
